notes.zh: 新增应用内更新提醒与设置中的检查更新入口。
notes.en: Adds in-app update reminders and a manual update check in Settings.

notes.zh: 个人资料支持修改性别。经期统一归属情侣空间中的女性成员，男方经授权可协助记录；修改性别后同步调整共享与提醒，保留历史。
notes.en: Adds editable profile gender. Period tracking belongs to the female member in the couple space, with optional partner assistance. Gender changes update sharing and reminders while preserving history.
